effects.description: Grave Points: Necromantic energy gathered from creatures near death, spent by Necromancer skills.
effects.name: Grave Points

props.description:
When another creature you can see loses Hit Points while in Crisis, if they are not undead, you gain 1 Grave Point. You may never have more than [SL + 1] Grave Points.

When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you lose all Grave Points; then, if you lost at least 1 Grave Point this way and this is the first time you are reduced to 0 HP during this scene, you do not Surrender nor Sacrifice yourself; instead, you recover an amount of HP equal to [SL, multiplied by the amount of Grave Points you lost this way].
props.name: Beyond the Realms of Death
props.passive_logic_resolution:
const DEBUG = true;

const TAG = "[PL-RES][BeyondTheRealmsOfDeath]";

const ctx = (typeof context !== "undefined" && context) ? context : {};

const p = (typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD) ? __PAYLOAD : {};

const globalTargets = (typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS)) ? __TARGETS : [];

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const log = (...args) => {

if (DEBUG) console.log(TAG, ...args);

};

const warn = (...args) => {

if (DEBUG) console.warn(TAG, ...args);

};

// Use this whenever the passive should NOT show a passive UI card.

const quietStop = (reason = "") => {

if (DEBUG && reason) console.log(TAG, "SKIP:", reason);

// Main intended passive-system cancel helper.

if (ctx.skipPassive) {

return ctx.skipPassive(reason || "No effect.", { notify: false });

}

// Fallback markers, just in case this script runs in a lighter context.

p.meta.__skipPassive = true;

p.meta.__skipPassiveCard = true;

p.meta.__passiveNoEffect = true;

p.meta.__passiveSkipReason = reason || "No effect.";

return undefined;

};

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const asArray = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v == null ? [] : [v]);

const toNumber = (v, fallback = 0) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

};

const collectionValues = (collectionLike) => {

if (!collectionLike) return [];

if (Array.isArray(collectionLike)) return collectionLike;

if (typeof collectionLike.values === "function") return Array.from(collectionLike.values());

return Array.from(collectionLike);

};

async function resolveDoc(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref !== "string") return ref;

try {

return await fromUuid(ref);

} catch (err) {

warn("fromUuid failed", { ref, err });

return null;

}

}

function actorFromDoc(doc) {

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor" || doc.constructor?.name === "Actor") return doc;

if (doc.actor) return doc.actor;

if (doc.object?.actor) return doc.object.actor;

if (doc.token?.actor) return doc.token.actor;

if (doc.document?.actor) return doc.document.actor;

return null;

}

async function resolveActor(ref) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(ref);

return actorFromDoc(doc);

}

async function resolveTokenDoc(ref) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Token" || doc.documentName === "TokenDocument") return doc;

if (doc.document?.documentName === "Token") return doc.document;

if (doc.token?.document) return doc.token.document;

return null;

}

function activeTokenUuidForActor(actor) {

try {

const tok =

actor?.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ??

actor?.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ??

null;

return tok?.document?.uuid ?? null;

} catch {

return null;

}

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1) Read trigger payload.

// This passive should only care about creature_takes_damage.

// --------------------------------------------------

const phaseRoot =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const phaseByTrigger =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

{};

const passiveTriggerKey =

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phaseRoot?.trigger ??

null;

const phase =

phaseByTrigger?.creature_takes_damage ??

(passiveTriggerKey && phaseByTrigger?.[passiveTriggerKey]) ??

phaseRoot ??

{};

const triggerName = phase?.trigger ?? passiveTriggerKey ?? "";

if (triggerName !== "creature_takes_damage") {

return quietStop(`Wrong trigger: ${triggerName || "none"}`);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2) Resolve passive owner and this skill item.

// --------------------------------------------------

const owner =

ctx.passiveOwner ??

(ctx.helpers?.getPassiveOwnerActor ? await ctx.helpers.getPassiveOwnerActor() : null) ??

((typeof __PASSIVE_ACTOR !== "undefined") ? __PASSIVE_ACTOR : null) ??

await resolveActor(

p?.meta?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

null

);

if (!owner) {

return quietStop("Could not resolve passive owner.");

}

const passiveItem =

ctx.passiveItem ??

(ctx.helpers?.getPassiveItem ? await ctx.helpers.getPassiveItem() : null) ??

((typeof __PASSIVE_ITEM !== "undefined") ? __PASSIVE_ITEM : null) ??

collectionValues(owner.items).find(i => norm(i?.name) === "beyond the realms of death");

if (!passiveItem) {

return quietStop("Could not resolve Beyond the Realms of Death item.");

}

const skillLevel = Math.max(0, parseInt(passiveItem.system?.props?.level ?? "0", 10) || 0);

if (skillLevel <= 0) {

return quietStop("Beyond the Realms of Death SL is 0.");

}

const maxGrave = Math.max(1, skillLevel + 1);

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3) Resolve damaged creature.

// For creature_takes_damage, the target side is the creature losing HP.

// --------------------------------------------------

const damagedActorUuid =

phase?.targetActorUuid ??

asArray(phase?.targetActorUuids)[0] ??

null;

const damagedTokenUuid =

phase?.targetTokenUuid ??

phase?.targetUuid ??

asArray(phase?.targetTokenUuids)[0] ??

asArray(phase?.targets)[0] ??

globalTargets[0] ??

null;

let damagedActor = null;

if (damagedActorUuid) {

damagedActor = await resolveActor(damagedActorUuid);

}

if (!damagedActor && damagedTokenUuid) {

damagedActor = await resolveActor(damagedTokenUuid);

}

if (!damagedActor) {

return quietStop("Could not resolve damaged creature.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4) "Another creature" check.

// Owner should not gain Grave Point when the owner is the damaged creature.

// --------------------------------------------------

const ownerActorUuid = owner.uuid ?? null;

const ownerTokenUuid = activeTokenUuidForActor(owner);

const damagedTokenDoc = damagedTokenUuid ? await resolveTokenDoc(damagedTokenUuid) : null;

const damagedTokenUuidResolved = damagedTokenDoc?.uuid ?? damagedTokenUuid ?? null;

if (ownerActorUuid && damagedActor.uuid === ownerActorUuid) {

return quietStop("Damaged creature is the passive owner.");

}

if (ownerTokenUuid && damagedTokenUuidResolved && ownerTokenUuid === damagedTokenUuidResolved) {

return quietStop("Damaged token is the passive owner's token.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5) Confirm real HP loss.

// Shield-only damage should not count as losing Hit Points.

// --------------------------------------------------

const hpBefore = toNumber(phase?.gmChanges?.hp?.from, NaN);

const hpAfter = toNumber(phase?.gmChanges?.hp?.to, NaN);

let hpLost = 0;

if (Number.isFinite(hpBefore) && Number.isFinite(hpAfter)) {

hpLost = Math.max(0, hpBefore - hpAfter);

} else {

hpLost = Math.max(

0,

Math.abs(toNumber(phase?.finalValue, 0)) ||

Math.abs(toNumber(phase?.displayedAmount, 0)) ||

Math.abs(toNumber(phase?.baseValue, 0))

);

}

if (phase?.affected === false || hpLost <= 0) {

return quietStop("Damage event did not cause HP loss.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 6) Check Crisis Active Effect.

// ID first, name/status fallback.

// --------------------------------------------------

const CRISIS_EFFECT_UUID = "Item.0gIBYzSpjdXS6f25.ActiveEffect.4ldx00srGNv5AJBr";

const CRISIS_EFFECT_ID = CRISIS_EFFECT_UUID.split(".").pop();

function isTruthy(v) {

return v === true || v === 1 || v === "1" || norm(v) === "true" || norm(v) === "yes";

}

function actorHasCrisis(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

const effects = collectionValues(actor.effects);

// ID/source UUID first.

for (const eff of effects) {

if (!eff || eff.disabled) continue;

const effId = String(eff.id ?? eff._id ?? "");

const effUuid = String(eff.uuid ?? "");

const effOrigin = String(eff.origin ?? "");

if (effId === CRISIS_EFFECT_ID) return true;

if (effUuid === CRISIS_EFFECT_UUID) return true;

if (effOrigin === CRISIS_EFFECT_UUID) return true;

}

// Name/status fallback.

for (const eff of effects) {

if (!eff || eff.disabled) continue;

const effName = norm(eff.name ?? eff.label ?? "");

if (effName === "crisis") return true;

const statuses = Array.from(eff.statuses ?? []).map(norm);

if (statuses.includes("crisis")) return true;

}

// Sheet mirror fallback, if your sheet has it.

const props = actor.system?.props ?? {};

if (isTruthy(props.isCrisis) || isTruthy(props.crisis)) return true;

return false;

}

if (!actorHasCrisis(damagedActor)) {

return quietStop(`${damagedActor.name} is not in Crisis.`);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 7) Undead check.

// Clean rule:

// - Check actor.system.props.species

// - If species is exactly UNDEAD, cancel.

// - If missing or anything else, assume not undead.

// --------------------------------------------------

function actorIsUndead(actor) {

const species = String(actor?.system?.props?.species ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();

return species === "UNDEAD";

}

if (actorIsUndead(damagedActor)) {

return quietStop(`${damagedActor.name} is UNDEAD.`);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 8) Gain 1 Grave Point, capped at SL + 1.

// If no point is actually gained, cancel silently so no passive card appears.

// --------------------------------------------------

const props = owner.system?.props ?? {};

const graveBefore = Math.max(0, toNumber(props.clock_grave, 0));

const graveAfter = Math.min(maxGrave, graveBefore + 1);

const graveGained = Math.max(0, graveAfter - graveBefore);

if (graveGained <= 0) {

return quietStop(`No Grave Point gained. Already at max (${graveBefore}/${maxGrave}).`);

}

await owner.update({

"system.props.clock_grave": graveAfter

});

log("APPLIED", {

owner: owner.name,

damagedCreature: damagedActor.name,

damagedCreatureSpecies: damagedActor.system?.props?.species ?? null,

hpLost,

skillLevel,

maxGrave,

graveBefore,

graveAfter,

graveGained

});
